bullets.text: An industrial fire broke out at the Fallon Coatings site on the Kellet Point industrial estate in Osmery on 2 December 2025.
Within the first two hours the fire prompted a public warning for the neighbouring districts of Brayle and Sunder Flats and the closure of Kellet Road between the industrial estate and Merrin Canal.
No casualties were reported in the opening phase of the incident.
The site operator, Fallon Coatings, deployed to the scene and authorities issued information on the Kellet Road closure while the response continued.
Late morning on the first day, a fire is reported at the Kellet Point industrial estate and the operator Fallon Coatings deploys to the site.
Minutes later, a warning is issued for Brayle and Sunder Flats.
Authorities provide information about Kellet Road and close the road through the industrial estate to Merrin Canal.
The Brayle warning continues to be relayed by media and outside accounts through the end of the window.
Kellet Road was closed through the Kellet Point industrial estate as far as Merrin Canal.
The primary hazard was an industrial fire at the Fallon Coatings site on the Kellet Point industrial estate.
Fallon Coatings, the site operator, deployed to the scene within the first hour of the fire.
A warning was issued for Brayle and Sunder Flats shortly after the fire was reported.
Authorities issued information about the Kellet Road closure as the response got under way.
